agent-questions: Styles and scans the native question card. It renders no surface of its own; the card it decorates belongs to DSH core and needs a live model turn to appear.
diff-viewed: Adds a Viewed toggle to the deliverables review pane. The pane only exists for a turn that produced reviewable files, and the scratch seeds create none.
goal-stall-guard: Host-side goal policy. It renders nothing itself: the pause, continue or close it decides appears in the native goal controls.
main-tabs: Its catalog path seeds a tool-call thread, and the tool-call-thread scratch seed stops in the AI Accounts panel before any turn runs.
multi-host: The runtime directory sits behind the host picker's menus and needs a registered second runtime or SSH host; a scratch instance seeds neither, and its own reach assumes a host already exists.
project-checks: The panel only opens from its composer command, which the command palette does not list, and the overlay renders no surface until a session directory has trusted actions.
prompt-stash: Its catalog path seeds a tool-call thread, and the tool-call-thread scratch seed stops in the AI Accounts panel before any turn runs.
pulls-review: Its catalog path seeds a rebase-ready thread and then drives the /pulls command, but the seeded thread cannot be selected from the sidebar the way the reach expects.
queue-reorder: Its catalog path starts from threads the e2e database fixture seeds (Queue source, Busy target); a scratch DSH creates neither.
send-after-upload: Its banner exists only while an attachment upload is still finishing, which a local scratch upload never holds open long enough to capture.
shared-runtime: Loads the one shared copy of the Client UI modules. It renders no surface of its own to screenshot.
shortcuts: Installs keyboard chords only. Every visible result belongs to the surface whose control the chord drives, not to this plugin.
test-runs: Its catalog path seeds a tool-call thread, and the tool-call-thread scratch seed stops in the AI Accounts panel before any turn runs.
tool-meta: Its catalog path seeds a tool-call thread, and the tool-call-thread scratch seed stops in the AI Accounts panel before any turn runs.
turn-summary: Its catalog path seeds a tool-call thread, and the tool-call-thread scratch seed stops in the AI Accounts panel before any turn runs.
ui-styles: Compiles and injects the shared plugin stylesheet once per page. It has no screen of its own, only the sheets other plugins render with.
workspace-folder-picker: Its directory flow opens from the workspace chip's own menu; the composer's folder picker is a different surface and never renders this picker's title.
